title: Add initial support for exporting generic classes

target.summary: ExportGenericClassToCpp registers the exported class template in clang_decls using the generic class type's instruction ID instead of its declaration ID. Because the duplicate check at the start of the function looks up class_info.first_decl_id(), this key mismatch causes cache misses when the generic class is exported again, resulting in duplicate C++ class template declarations.
